```{r}
# Function to Create Coefficient Plot
create_coefficient_plot <- function(file_path, title) {
  data <- read.csv(file_path)
  
  # Determine colors based on whether the confidence interval includes 0
  data$Color <- ifelse(data$Lower > 0 | data$Upper < 0, "green3", "tomato")
  
  # Add an index column
  data$Index <- seq_len(nrow(data))
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Index, y = Parameter)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Color), size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +  # Only plot points with color coding
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 2) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    ylim(-0.35, 0.5) +   # Changed y-limit to 0.5
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "",
      y = "Beta Coefficient"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 44, hjust = 0.2, face = "bold"), # Slightly bigger title
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 1),
      legend.position = "none"  # Ensure no legend appears
    )
}

# Function to parse specifications
parse_specification <- function(spec) {
  list(
    Proportion = ifelse(grepl("Proportion", spec), 1, 0),
    Pearson = ifelse(grepl("Pearson", spec), 1, 0),
    Spearman = ifelse(grepl("Spearman", spec), 1, 0),
    Euclid = ifelse(grepl("Euclid", spec), 1, 0),
    Pairwise = ifelse(grepl("Pairwise", spec), 1, 0),
    Entropy = ifelse(grepl("_Entropy", spec) & !grepl("No_Entropy", spec), 1, 0),
    More_Than_10_Responses = ifelse(grepl("More_Than_10_Responses|MT10R_AND_MT20S", spec), 1, 0),
    More_Than_20_Seconds = ifelse(grepl("More_Than_20_Seconds|MT10R_AND_MT20S", spec), 1, 0),
    Start_Date = ifelse(grepl("Start_Date|Date_and_Time", spec), 1, 0),
    Response_Window = ifelse(grepl("Response_Window|Date_and_Time", spec), 1, 0),
    Demographics = ifelse(grepl("_Demographics", spec) & !grepl("No_Demographics", spec), 1, 0),
    Baseline_ER = ifelse(grepl("_Baseline_ER", spec) & !grepl("No_Baseline_ER", spec), 1, 0)
  )
}

create_specification_plot <- function(file_path) {
  data <- read.csv(file_path)
  
  # Apply the parsing function to each row and create a new dataframe
  parsed_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(data$Specification, parse_specification))
  parsed_data <- as.data.frame(parsed_data)
  
  # Add an Index column for alignment with the parameter plot
  parsed_data$Index <- seq_len(nrow(parsed_data))
  
  parsed_data <- parsed_data %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  
  # Define the desired order of variables for plotting
  variable_order <- c(
    "More_Than_10_Responses", "More_Than_20_Seconds", "Proportion", 
    "Pearson", "Spearman", "Euclid", "Pairwise", 
    "Entropy", "Start_Date", "Response_Window", "Demographics", "Baseline_ER"
  )
  
  # Transform the data to long format for ggplot
  long_data <- parsed_data %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Index, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = gsub("More_Than_10_Responses", ">10_Resp", Variable),
      Variable = gsub("More_Than_20_Seconds", ">20_Sec", Variable),
      Variable = gsub("Response_Window", "Resp_Wind", Variable),
      Variable = factor(Variable, levels = c(
        ">10_Resp", ">20_Sec", "Proportion", 
        "Pearson", "Spearman", "Euclid", "Pairwise", 
        "Entropy", "Start_Date", "Resp_Wind", "Demographics", "Baseline_ER"
      )),
      Value = as.factor(Value)  # Convert Value to a factor for discrete scale
    )
  
  # Define color mapping for variable groups
  color_mapping <- c(
    ">10_Resp" = "firebrick", ">20_Sec" = "firebrick",
    "Proportion" = "steelblue",
    "Pearson" = "seagreen", "Spearman" = "seagreen", "Euclid" = "seagreen", 
    "Pairwise" = "darkgoldenrod", 
    "Entropy" = "sienna", "Start_Date" = "sienna", "Resp_Wind" = "sienna", 
    "Demographics" = "sienna", "Baseline_ER" = "sienna"
  )
  
  # Ensure fill mapping correctly applies colors only to "1" values
  long_data <- long_data %>%
    mutate(Fill = ifelse(Value == "1", as.character(Variable), NA))
  
  ggplot(long_data, aes(x = Index, y = Variable, fill = Fill)) +
    geom_tile(height = 0.8) +  # Add height to create gaps between rows
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = color_mapping,  # Just use the color mapping
      na.value = "white",  # Make NA values appear white
      name = "Value"
      ) +
    labs(
      x = "Specification",
      y = "Analytic Dimension"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

plots_na <- list()
for (i in seq_along(file_paths_na)) {
  coefficient_plot <- create_coefficient_plot(file_paths_na[i], titles_na[i])
  specification_plot <- create_specification_plot(file_paths_na[i])
  plots_na[[i]] <- coefficient_plot / specification_plot + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))  # Stack plots with adjusted heights
}

final_plot_na <- wrap_plots(plots_na, ncol = 5, guides = "collect") + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Second-Order Multiverse Analysis: Negative Affect (NA)", theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 54, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")))
```

```{r}
# Helper to extract strategy name from file path
get_strategy <- function(path) {
  sub(".*_(RP|SP|DS|SA|SS)_(multi|single)\\.csv$", "\\1", path)
}
get_blocktype <- function(blockname) {
  if (grepl("multi$", blockname)) "Joint" else "Single"
}

results_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(all_blocks), function(blockname) {
  files <- all_blocks[[blockname]]
  bind_rows(lapply(files, function(fp) {
    dat <- read.csv(fp)
    tibble(
      Outcome = substr(blockname, 1, 2),  # NA, PA, ST
      Block   = get_blocktype(blockname),
      Strategy = get_strategy(fp),
      Total   = nrow(dat),
      Sig     = sum(dat$Lower > 0 | dat$Upper < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(Percent = round(100 * Sig / Total, 3))

print(results_summary, n = Inf)
```
```{r}
# Helper: parse a shared spec id by removing "<Outcome>_<Strategy>_" and ".csv"
parse_spec_id <- function(spec, outcome, strategy) {
  spec |>
    sub("\\.csv$", "", x = _) |>
    sub(paste0("^", outcome, "_", strategy, "_"), "", x = _)
}

# Core: for an outcome ("NA", "PA", "ST") and its *_multi files, compute counts
get_significance_summary <- function(outcome, files_vec) {
  dat_list <- lapply(files_vec, function(fp) {
    strategy <- get_strategy(fp)

    df <- read.csv(fp, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    # Be robust to slight name differences in the specification column
    spec_col <- if ("Specification" %in% names(df)) {
      "Specification"
    } else {
      cand <- names(df)[grepl("pec", names(df), ignore.case = TRUE)]
      if (length(cand) == 0) stop("Couldn't find a Specification column in: ", fp)
      cand[1]
    }

    tibble(
      spec_id  = parse_spec_id(df[[spec_col]], outcome, strategy),
      Strategy = strategy,
      SigFlag  = (df$Lower > 0 | df$Upper < 0)
    )
  })

  combined_long <- bind_rows(dat_list)

  strategies <- c("RP", "SP", "DS", "SA", "SS")
  wide <- combined_long |>
    distinct(spec_id, Strategy, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = spec_id,
      names_from = Strategy,
      values_from = SigFlag,
      values_fill = FALSE
    )

  present <- intersect(strategies, names(wide))
  wide <- wide |>
    mutate(
      Outcome = outcome,
      Num_Significant_Strategies = rowSums(across(all_of(present)), na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  total_specs <- nrow(wide)

  distribution <- wide |>
    count(Outcome, Num_Significant_Strategies, name = "Num_Specifications") |>
    complete(
      Outcome = outcome,
      Num_Significant_Strategies = 0:5,
      fill = list(Num_Specifications = 0)
    ) |>
    mutate(Percent = round(100 * Num_Specifications / total_specs, 3)) |>
    arrange(Outcome, Num_Significant_Strategies)

  list(
    by_spec = wide |> arrange(spec_id),
    distribution = distribution
  )
}

# Run for each outcome using the *_multi (joint) sets
na_res <- get_significance_summary("NA", all_blocks$NA_multi)
pa_res <- get_significance_summary("PA", all_blocks$PA_multi)
st_res <- get_significance_summary("ST", all_blocks$ST_multi)

# Combined distribution table
signif_strategy_distribution <- bind_rows(
  na_res$distribution, pa_res$distribution, st_res$distribution
)

print(signif_strategy_distribution, n = Inf)
```

--NO COVARIATES--
```{r}
# Helper: returns TRUE if any covariate analytic dimension is present
contains_covariate <- function(spec) {
  parsed <- parse_specification(spec)
  # These are the covariates (coded sienna)
  covariates <- c("Entropy", "Start_Date", "Response_Window", "Demographics", "Baseline_ER")
  any(unlist(parsed)[covariates] == 1)
}

# Function to Create Coefficient Plot (subsetted to no covariate specs)
create_coefficient_plot_no_cov <- function(file_path, title) {
  data <- read.csv(file_path)
  # Filter out specs with any covariate
  data <- data[!sapply(data$Specification, contains_covariate), ]
  # Determine colors based on whether the confidence interval includes 0
  data$Color <- ifelse(data$Lower > 0 | data$Upper < 0, "green3", "tomato")
  # Add an index column
  data$Index <- seq_len(nrow(data))
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Index, y = Parameter)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Color), size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 2) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    ylim(-0.35, 0.75) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "",
      y = "Beta Coefficient"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 38, hjust = 0.2, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 1),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# Function to Create Specification Plot (subsetted to no covariate specs)
create_specification_plot_no_cov <- function(file_path) {
  data <- read.csv(file_path)
  # Filter out specs with any covariate
  data <- data[!sapply(data$Specification, contains_covariate), ]
  # Apply the parsing function to each row and create a new dataframe
  parsed_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(data$Specification, parse_specification))
  parsed_data <- as.data.frame(parsed_data)
  parsed_data$Index <- seq_len(nrow(parsed_data))
  parsed_data <- parsed_data %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  variable_order <- c(
    "More_Than_10_Responses", "More_Than_20_Seconds", "Proportion", 
    "Pearson", "Spearman", "Euclid", "Pairwise", 
    "Entropy", "Start_Date", "Response_Window", "Demographics", "Baseline_ER"
  )
  long_data <- parsed_data %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Index, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = gsub("More_Than_10_Responses", ">10_Resp", Variable),
      Variable = gsub("More_Than_20_Seconds", ">20_Sec", Variable),
      Variable = gsub("Response_Window", "Resp_Wind", Variable),
      Variable = factor(Variable, levels = c(
        ">10_Resp", ">20_Sec", "Proportion", 
        "Pearson", "Spearman", "Euclid", "Pairwise", 
        "Entropy", "Start_Date", "Resp_Wind", "Demographics", "Baseline_ER"
      )),
      Value = as.factor(Value)
    )
  color_mapping <- c(
    ">10_Resp" = "firebrick", ">20_Sec" = "firebrick",
    "Proportion" = "steelblue",
    "Pearson" = "seagreen", "Spearman" = "seagreen", "Euclid" = "seagreen", 
    "Pairwise" = "darkgoldenrod", 
    "Entropy" = "sienna", "Start_Date" = "sienna", "Resp_Wind" = "sienna", 
    "Demographics" = "sienna", "Baseline_ER" = "sienna"
  )
  long_data <- long_data %>%
    mutate(Fill = ifelse(Value == "1", as.character(Variable), NA))
  ggplot(long_data, aes(x = Index, y = Variable, fill = Fill)) +
    geom_tile(height = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = color_mapping,
      na.value = "white",
      name = "Value"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Specification",
      y = "Analytic Dimension"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Function to Create Coefficient Plot
create_coefficient_plot <- function(file_path, title) {
  data <- read.csv(file_path)
  
  # Determine colors based on whether the confidence interval includes 0
  data$Color <- ifelse(data$Lower > 0 | data$Upper < 0, "green3", "tomato")
  
  # Add an index column
  data$Index <- seq_len(nrow(data))
  
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Index, y = Parameter)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Color), size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +  # Only plot points with color coding
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 2) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    ylim(-0.35, 0.75) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "",
      y = "Beta Coefficient"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 38, hjust = 0.2, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 1),
      legend.position = "none"  # Ensure no legend appears
    )
}


# Function to parse specifications
parse_specification <- function(spec) {
  list(
    Proportion = ifelse(grepl("Proportion", spec), 1, 0),
    Pearson = ifelse(grepl("Pearson", spec), 1, 0),
    Spearman = ifelse(grepl("Spearman", spec), 1, 0),
    Euclid = ifelse(grepl("Euclid", spec), 1, 0),
    Pairwise = ifelse(grepl("Pairwise", spec), 1, 0),
    Entropy = ifelse(grepl("_Entropy", spec) & !grepl("No_Entropy", spec), 1, 0),
    More_Than_10_Responses = ifelse(grepl("More_Than_10_Responses|MT10R_AND_MT20S", spec), 1, 0),
    More_Than_20_Seconds = ifelse(grepl("More_Than_20_Seconds|MT10R_AND_MT20S", spec), 1, 0),
    Start_Date = ifelse(grepl("Start_Date|Date_and_Time", spec), 1, 0),
    Response_Window = ifelse(grepl("Response_Window|Date_and_Time", spec), 1, 0),
    Demographics = ifelse(grepl("_Demographics", spec) & !grepl("No_Demographics", spec), 1, 0),
    Baseline_ER = ifelse(grepl("_Baseline_ER", spec) & !grepl("No_Baseline_ER", spec), 1, 0)
  )
}

create_specification_plot <- function(file_path) {
  data <- read.csv(file_path)
  
  # Apply the parsing function to each row and create a new dataframe
  parsed_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(data$Specification, parse_specification))
  parsed_data <- as.data.frame(parsed_data)
  
  # Add an Index column for alignment with the parameter plot
  parsed_data$Index <- seq_len(nrow(parsed_data))
  
  parsed_data <- parsed_data %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  
  # Define the desired order of variables for plotting
  variable_order <- c(
    "More_Than_10_Responses", "More_Than_20_Seconds", "Proportion", 
    "Pearson", "Spearman", "Euclid", "Pairwise", 
    "Entropy", "Start_Date", "Response_Window", "Demographics", "Baseline_ER"
  )
  
  # Transform the data to long format for ggplot
  long_data <- parsed_data %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Index, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = gsub("More_Than_10_Responses", ">10_Resp", Variable),
      Variable = gsub("More_Than_20_Seconds", ">20_Sec", Variable),
      Variable = gsub("Response_Window", "Resp_Wind", Variable),
      Variable = factor(Variable, levels = c(
        ">10_Resp", ">20_Sec", "Proportion", 
        "Pearson", "Spearman", "Euclid", "Pairwise", 
        "Entropy", "Start_Date", "Resp_Wind", "Demographics", "Baseline_ER"
      )),
      Value = as.factor(Value)  # Convert Value to a factor for discrete scale
    )
  
  # Define color mapping for variable groups
  color_mapping <- c(
    ">10_Resp" = "firebrick", ">20_Sec" = "firebrick",
    "Proportion" = "steelblue",
    "Pearson" = "seagreen", "Spearman" = "seagreen", "Euclid" = "seagreen", 
    "Pairwise" = "darkgoldenrod", 
    "Entropy" = "sienna", "Start_Date" = "sienna", "Resp_Wind" = "sienna", 
    "Demographics" = "sienna", "Baseline_ER" = "sienna"
  )
  
  # Ensure fill mapping correctly applies colors only to "1" values
  long_data <- long_data %>%
    mutate(Fill = ifelse(Value == "1", as.character(Variable), NA))
  
  ggplot(long_data, aes(x = Index, y = Variable, fill = Fill)) +
    geom_tile(height = 0.8) +  # Add height to create gaps between rows
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = color_mapping,  # Just use the color mapping
      na.value = "white",  # Make NA values appear white
      name = "Value"
      ) +
    labs(
      x = "Specification",
      y = "Analytic Dimension"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# Create and combine the plots
```

```{r}
# Helper to extract strategy name from file path
get_strategy <- function(path) {
  sub(".*_(RP|SP|DS|SA|SS)_multi\\.csv$", "\\1", path)
}

get_blocktype <- function(blockname) "Joint"

results_summary_no_corr <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(all_blocks_no_corr), function(blockname) {
  files <- all_blocks_no_corr[[blockname]]
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(files, function(fp) {
    dat <- read.csv(fp)
    tibble::tibble(
      Outcome = substr(blockname, 1, 2),  # NA, PA, ST
      Block   = get_blocktype(blockname),
      Strategy = get_strategy(fp),
      Total   = nrow(dat),
      Sig     = sum(dat$Lower > 0 | dat$Upper < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }))
})) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Percent = round(100 * Sig / Total, 3))

print(results_summary_no_corr, n = Inf)

# Helper: parse a shared spec id by removing "<Outcome>_<Strategy>_" and ".csv"
parse_spec_id <- function(spec, outcome, strategy) {
  spec |>
    sub("\\.csv$", "", x = _) |>
    sub(paste0("^", outcome, "_", strategy, "_"), "", x = _)
}

# Core: for an outcome ("NA", "PA", "ST") and its *_multi files, compute counts
get_significance_summary_no_corr <- function(outcome, files_vec) {
  dat_list <- lapply(files_vec, function(fp) {
    strategy <- get_strategy(fp)

    df <- read.csv(fp, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

    # Be robust to slight name differences in the specification column
    spec_col <- if ("Specification" %in% names(df)) {
      "Specification"
    } else {
      cand <- names(df)[grepl("pec", names(df), ignore.case = TRUE)]
      if (length(cand) == 0) stop("Couldn't find a Specification column in: ", fp)
      cand[1]
    }

    tibble::tibble(
      spec_id  = parse_spec_id(df[[spec_col]], outcome, strategy),
      Strategy = strategy,
      SigFlag  = (df$Lower > 0 | df$Upper < 0)
    )
  })

  combined_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(dat_list)

  strategies <- c("RP", "SP", "DS", "SA", "SS")
  wide <- combined_long |>
    dplyr::distinct(spec_id, Strategy, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = spec_id,
      names_from = Strategy,
      values_from = SigFlag,
      values_fill = FALSE
    )

  present <- intersect(strategies, names(wide))
  wide <- wide |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Outcome = outcome,
      Num_Significant_Strategies = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(present)), na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  total_specs <- nrow(wide)

  distribution <- wide |>
    dplyr::count(Outcome, Num_Significant_Strategies, name = "Num_Specifications") |>
    tidyr::complete(
      Outcome = outcome,
      Num_Significant_Strategies = 0:5,
      fill = list(Num_Specifications = 0)
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Percent = round(100 * Num_Specifications / total_specs, 3)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(Outcome, Num_Significant_Strategies)

  list(
    by_spec = wide |> dplyr::arrange(spec_id),
    distribution = distribution
  )
}

# Run for each outcome using the *_multi (joint) sets
na_res_nc <- get_significance_summary_no_corr("NA", all_blocks_no_corr$NA_multi)
pa_res_nc <- get_significance_summary_no_corr("PA", all_blocks_no_corr$PA_multi)
st_res_nc <- get_significance_summary_no_corr("ST", all_blocks_no_corr$ST_multi)

# Combined distribution table
signif_strategy_distribution_no_corr <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  na_res_nc$distribution, pa_res_nc$distribution, st_res_nc$distribution
)

print(signif_strategy_distribution_no_corr, n = Inf)
```
